column1: # mtg-table cubes/library/census.tsv: the library census's population (Phase 0, D445), one row a card of library-pool.tsv.
# Written by tools/cubelab.sh census build (tools/cubelab/census.ts); do not edit by hand. `census build --check` fails when it is stale.

# Inputs: library-pool.tsv sha256 ccd1123660dd; editions sha256 936433dac9bb (Forge's res/editions, 678 files); meta:evybaby-cube-360 sha256 1dac8d7247a9; meta:fair-fight-cube-180 sha256 71d74e5b0735; meta:modern-era-cube-180 sha256 2506a126de6d; meta:omega-cube-180 sha256 a8bbe4635a83; meta:pauper-cube-180 sha256 f7e953db7a5a; meta:peasant-cube-180 sha256 0ec4efdb838f; meta:synergy-cube-180 sha256 add24ec2e8c5; meta:vintage-cube-180 sha256 a25e7be7d999 (ForgeCoach's public/cubes).
# name, sources, forge_supported, forge_ai_flag, colour_identity, type, mana_value: library-pool.tsv's columns (the engine's facts), copied.
# lowest_rarity: the lowest rarity of any printing in Forge's edition files ([cards] and the other printing sections, not [tokens]), C < U < R < M < S, Forge's L (a booster's land slot) read as C;

# lowest_rarity_set: the edition printing it at that rarity, a paper set's own (Core, Expansion, Reprint, Draft, Starter, Commander, Duel_Deck, Multiplayer, Boxed_Set) first, then an Online edition, then a promo or collector product, then the earliest Date, then the code. Both blank for a card no edition prints.

# lab_games, lab_wr_shrunk: the cube lab's metas (evybaby-cube-360, fair-fight-cube-180, modern-era-cube-180, omega-cube-180, pauper-cube-180, peasant-cube-180, synergy-cube-180, vintage-cube-180), games summed over every meta that played the card and winRateShrunk averaged with those games as weights; the rate is blank under 80 games.
# member_vintage: in vintage180 or mtgovc; member_peasant: in peasant; member_pauper: in pauper; member_legacy: in any other list (the legacy-ish lists).
# BAND, the first rule that applies: powered = on the POWERED list below; pauper = ever printed at common (rarity:C); peasant = ever at uncommon and never at common (rarity:U);
# legacy = everything else with a printing (rarity:R, rarity:M, rarity:S); a card no edition prints goes by membership: a Pauper cube -> pauper, else a Peasant cube -> peasant, else legacy

# (membership:pauper, membership:peasant, membership:other). band_source says which rule fired. provisional = 1 on every row: the labels stand until the census's first round, whose re-labelling rule is written before it runs.
# POWERED, the Power Nine (9): Black Lotus; Ancestral Recall; Time Walk; Timetwister; Mox Pearl; Mox Sapphire; Mox Jet; Mox Ruby; Mox Emerald.
# POWERED, the original dual lands (10): Tundra; Underground Sea; Badlands; Taiga; Savannah; Scrubland; Volcanic Island; Bayou; Plateau; Tropical Island.
# POWERED, named by the programme (10): Library of Alexandria; Bazaar of Baghdad; Mishra's Workshop; Candelabra of Tawnos; Sol Ring; Mana Crypt; Mana Vault; Time Vault; Tolarian Academy; Strip Mine.

# POWERED, the Vintage cubes' restricted-style cards (12): Balance; Demonic Tutor; Imperial Seal; Lion's Eye Diamond; Memory Jar; Mystic Forge; Mystical Tutor; Narset, Parter of Veils; Tinker; Vampiric Tutor; Wheel of Fortune; Yawgmoth's Will.
# Restricted in Vintage but printed at common, so banded by rarity: Brainstorm; Gitaxian Probe; Gush; Lotus Petal; Treasure Cruise.
# 1592 cards: pauper 444 (rarity:C 444); peasant 425 (rarity:U 425); legacy 682 (membership:other 24, rarity:M 114, rarity:R 544); powered 41 (powered-list 41).
# Supported by Forge 2.0.14 (drawable unless a basic land): pauper 444, peasant 425, legacy 658, powered 41; 814 cards have 80+ lab games.
